subject: Senior clearance request: CareSpring hosted-API strategic pricing (>20% requested)
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Aug 2029 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Senior clearance request: CareSpring hosted-API strategic pricing (>20% requested)

Team —

As discussed on the motion with CareSpring, they are asking for a 28% blended discount off list for Hosted API usage in exchange for a 3-year committed consumption agreement (annual minimums with quarterly ramp milestones). I need senior clearance to proceed to legal & procurement with the concession.

Quick summary:
- Customer: CareSpring Health (Lena Ortiz / Tom Hargreaves)
- Proposed commit: $1.2M year 1 (consumption-based, prepay credit option), $2.4M year 2, $3.6M year 3 (stair-step ramp)
- Requested concession: 28% off list for Hosted API token usage (blended across models used)
- Rationale: strategic healthcare partner, potential marketplace channel later, strong public-facing reference, multi-region rollout planned (US primary, EU later)
- Risk mitigations: 30-day SLA credit cap, strict usage thresholds tied to ramp, data residency limited to US regions initially, KMS with customer-managed keys (requested)

Why this is strategic: CareSpring has indicated willingness to co-sponsor a joint case study and commit to being a marketplace referral partner after year 1. Their product surfaces will drive predictable token volume beyond the commit if onboarding and model recommendations perform.

Unit economics / ask details (attached worksheet):
- Year 1 committed spend: $1.2M -> blended effective price replaces list yielding 28% ARR concession; break-even model still positive under our forecast given expected caching & model-selection optimizations.
- If approved, I propose the following guardrails: staged approval with a swing-back clause if ramp < 60% of forecast in first 6 months; prepay credits to be held in escrow clause (legal to draft).

Ask: Senior clearance to approve up to 28% off Hosted API list for the CareSpring 3-year commit so we can move to final MOU and DocuSign. Preferable: final sign-off by Fri 30 Aug EOD PT to keep the procurement cadence with their quarter close.

Attachments: CareSpring_Pricing_Worksheet.xlsx, CareSpring_MOU_v2.pdf, Usage_forecast_Q1-Q4_2030.csv

Thanks —
Priyom

Date: Tue, 20 Aug 2029 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Senior clearance request: CareSpring hosted-API strategic pricing (>20% requested)

Thanks Priyom — quick clarifying Qs before I escalate this to pricing committee:
1) Is the 28% uniform across all model classes or tiered? Please point me to the blended calc in the worksheet (tab called "blended-summary").
2) What precedent do we have for marketplace referral commitments as material consideration? Who signs off on the marketing/case-study terms?
3) Any legal redlines expected on data residency / KMS that would change the economics?

If you can answer inline I can prep a short exec memo. Also please confirm the committed minimums per quarter (I saw the year numbers but need Q1/Q2 ramp breakpoints).

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Manager, Deal Desk, Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Aug 2029 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Senior clearance request: CareSpring hosted-API strategic pricing (>20% requested)

Karthik — answers below (pulled from attached worksheet v2):

1) Pricing mix: blended across three model classes (embedding-heavy calls, small-context classification, and L2 chat). The worksheet tab "blended-summary" shows the weighted average by token-type. The 28% is blended; per-model discounts are tiered (15–32% depending on model family and forecast volume).

2) Marketplace & marketing commitment: CareSpring has committed in writing to a joint case study and an annual co-marketing budget ($50k/year for shared events/PR) beginning year 2. We don't have a formal channel contract yet — marketing Legal will review and sign off on terms. Marketing has provisionally agreed the case study is acceptable as commercial consideration but legal needs to sign off.

3) Legal redlines: customer requested customer-managed KMS (supported), plus an EU residency addendum after Q4 of year 1. Legal flagged the KMS clause as standard (no material econ impact). The EU addendum could increase infra cost in year 2 but we planned for a markup in year 2 pricing to account for that.

Quarter breakpoints (committed minimums):
- Q1 2030: $200k (onboarding + pilot)
- Q2 2030: $300k
- Q3 2030: $350k
- Q4 2030: $350k (total Y1 = $1.2M)

I've attached MOU v2 with the ramp schedule and the prepay credit schedule (CareSpring prefers a 6-month rolling prepay to start).

If you want, I can draft a 1-pager exec memo summarizing the business case; otherwise request you route to Rishi for senior consideration.

Priyom

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Aug 2029 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Senior clearance request: CareSpring hosted-API strategic pricing (>20% requested)

Team — after reviewing the worksheet and the ramp protections, I approve the requested concession up to 28% off Hosted API list for the proposed 3-year CareSpring commitment. Approval conditions:

1) Approval is conditional on the final MOU including the staged ramp checkpoints and a clawback clause if actual billed usage < 60% of committed minimums in the first 6 months.
2) Legal must include an escrow-style holdback for prepay credits (or an alternative credit hold) to protect revenue recognition if onboarding stalls.
3) Marketing to sign off on the case-study language and a published timeline (no later than end of year 2) before we move to signature.

Please proceed: Karthik, route to Legal to prepare the amendment and DocuSign envelope. Priyom — coordinate with Lena to finalize the signature timeline; copy me on the DocuSign.

Rishi
